2608.23965.title: RAGSentinel: Certifiable Geometric Consensus for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation
2608.23965.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves the factuality of large language models by grounding responses in external documents, but it also exposes a critical security vulnerability: adversarial documents injected into the knowledge database can enter the context window and steer the model toward targeted incorrect answers. Existing post-retrieval defenses rely on instruction following, parametric knowledge, or text-level consistency, all of which can be imitated or optimized against by adaptive attackers. We propose RAGSentinel, a training-free, label-free defense for black-box RAG systems. RAGSentinel uses a surrogate encoder to measure query-conditioned hidden-state shifts induced by retrieved documents, removes shared topic directions, and filters poisoned documents as geometric outliers from a robust majority consensus. We prove that, under an honest-majority assumption and a representation-level separation condition, RAGSentinel exactly recovers a poison-free majority-sized context. Experiments across three question-answering datasets, three LLM families, and multiple poisoning attacks show that RAGSentinel consistently achieves low attack success rates while preserving competitive accuracy and remaining effective against adaptive attacks with full pipeline knowledge.
2608.23965.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）透過將回應基於外部文件來提高大型語言模型的事實性，但它也暴露了一個關鍵的安全漏洞：注入知識數據庫的對抗性文件可以進入上下文窗口，並引導模型朝向目標錯誤答案。現有的檢索後防禦依賴於指令遵循、參數知識或文本級一致性，這些都可以被適應性攻擊者模仿或優化。我們提出了RAGSentinel，一種無需訓練和標籤的黑盒RAG系統防禦。RAGSentinel使用替代編碼器來測量由檢索文件引起的查詢條件隱藏狀態變化，去除共享主題方向，並將有毒文件作為幾何異常從穩健的多數共識中過濾掉。我們證明，在誠實多數假設和表示級分離條件下，RAGSentinel能夠準確恢復無毒的多數大小上下文。在三個問答數據集、三個LLM系列和多種毒化攻擊的實驗中顯示，RAGSentinel始終實現低攻擊成功率，同時保持競爭性的準確性，並在擁有完整管道知識的情況下對適應性攻擊仍然有效。
